name: print-social-orange-genius-business-ideas-post-with-labelled-sections
title: Orange 'Genius Business Ideas' post with boxed headline, labelled text sections and brush-edge footer
whatItIs: A square white-and-orange post with a smiling man in an orange denim jacket on a phone, fading into white, a headline where 'BUSINESS' sits in an orange box, orange labels 'About us' and 'Online webinar' over paragraphs, and an orange footer with a rough brush edge.
whatItMeans: Cheerful and informative; labels structure the copy like a mini brochure.
techniques: Box the middle word of a three-line headline.
Head short paragraphs with small colour labels.
Give the footer a brushed torn edge.

vocabulary.definition: A small coloured tag heading a block of text.
